desc: The 1911 Carry B45 is an upgraded 1911 in 45ACP with a 4 1/4" barrel featuring many high end upgrades at a very reasonable price. Rotary hammer forged hard chrome plated barrel, hammer forged frame and slide, Novak style three dot sights, extended beavertail style grip safety, enhanced hammer and trigger, extended and ambidextrous thumb safety, beveled magazine well.
